title: VSift skill.status data v1
description: The data of a skill.status result (0.3.0, ADR 0038 section 3), read only: what is at each of the two skill folders of the scope, read without following a link, beside this release's skill. absent: nothing; current: this release's skill byte for byte; different: a folder whose SKILL.md names the skill vsift, with other bytes (another version, or edited); link: a symbolic link or junction, never followed; not_vsift: a file, or a folder that is not a vsift skill; parent_not_folder: .claude, .agents or their skills folder is a link or not a folder. files lists the skill's files by the names skill show takes.

scope.description: user: below the person's home folder; project: below the folder --project named. No result names an absolute path.

skill_digest.description: SHA-256 over this release's skill: each file in name order as its name, a NUL, its length in decimal, a NUL and its bytes.
